title: Cloudflare tunnel: decision register describes a different tunnel than the one running
evidence: LIBRARIAN-REVIEW.html. Register says '--token tunnel pid 8611'; actually running is 'cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:7676' pid 83677.

spec.description: The recorded decision describes a named/token tunnel; what is actually running is a QUICK tunnel pointed at an unrelated service on port 7676. A host-specific observation was written down as a general claim.
spec.context: Consequence: any plan that assumes a dashboard route is the only lever is reasoning from the wrong tunnel type. Quick tunnels are not configured through the dashboard. CONFIRM THE TUNNEL TYPE ON THE MINI before assuming the dashboard is the only control surface, and record which host the observation came from so the next reader does not inherit the same generalisation.
